column1: # Rakoczi 1632 'mandata' cipher (Clm 10401 n.139): homophonic substitution of Latin letters by numbers 1-99 and a few signs,
# plus 3-digit code words for names. Built ONLY from glossed pairs on fol. 491r (Camerarius's interlinear decipherment),
# then frozen (3 Nov 2026) before the held-out test on fol. 491v. u=v, i=j.
# status: gloss = from glossed words (n = number of glossed occurrences); context = from an unglossed word only (doubtful);
# two = the group stands for two letters on this page (both glossed).
